answer: Sublinear Coordination Tax Registry. Agents submit transactions through dynamic routing groups where gas fees scale sublinearly with group size, turning a fable of cheap scale into a strict economic penalty. The protocol measures network topology at its zenith, applying an exponential multiplier to fees for any cluster sharing correlated execution paths. An attacker adding sybil nodes pays a compounding coordination tax because automated graph analysis detects overlapping state reads, forcing redundant bots to fund the very consensus capacity they attempt to dilute under a velvet rope of math.
